scope: Independent source review and six-case GUI follow-up for table-cell color parser correction.
review_findings: Only the textFillPending branch changes: active cell receives the representative text color; enclosing shape does not.
The existing first-color behavior for the single-color PmlTableCell model is retained; later colored runs do not overwrite it.
tcPr fill, stroke, shape fill and regular shape text-color precedence remain unchanged.
New raw-XML regression covers black and themed colors, automatic empty color, separate fills, later runs and neighboring shape isolation.
New round-trip regression preserves explicit RGB and automatic cell colors, fills, text and neighbor shape properties over three save/reopen cycles.
All original GUI export/color assertions are intact, and new raster/control assertions pass.
qualification_counting: Focused correction proof only; does not replace or add counts to the full incoming-layout-theme-accepted run.
